name: bell_pair
qiskit:
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, transpile
from qiskit_aer import AerSimulator

# Generated by QuantumCanvas  —  Bell Pair — Quantum Entanglement
# Pattern: bell_pair

qc = QuantumCircuit(2, 2)

# INITIALIZE — all qubits start in |0⟩ (Qiskit default, no gates needed)

# SHAKE Q1 — Hadamard: equal superposition
qc.h(0)

# ENTANGLE Q1 → Q2 — CNOT: entangle pair
qc.cx(0, 1)

# MEASURE Q1 — measure into classical bits
qc.measure(0, 0)

# MEASURE Q2 (correlated) — measure into classical bits
qc.measure(1, 1)

# ── Run on Aer simulator ──────────────────────────────────────
simulator = AerSimulator()
compiled  = transpile(qc, simulator)
job       = simulator.run(compiled, shots=1000)
result    = job.result()
counts    = result.get_counts()

print("Circuit:")
print(qc.draw(output="text"))

print("\nMeasurement counts (1000 shots):")
for state, count in sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1]):
    print(f"  |{state}⟩: {count} ({count/10:.1f}%)")
